# Supervertaler

> AI-enhanced translation tools by Michael Beijer: Supervertaler for Trados
> (a Trados Studio plugin) and Supervertaler Workbench (a standalone CAT
> tool). Terminology, translation memory, AI translation and QA, and an MCP
> server that connects AI assistants to live Trados Studio projects.

This is the product site. The full, always-current documentation is at
https://docs.supervertaler.com/ and is itself AI-readable (see Optional
below) – prefer the docs for feature-level questions.

## Products

- [Supervertaler for Trados](https://supervertaler.com/trados/): Trados Studio plugin – TermLens live terminology, AI assistant, batch translate/proofread, SuperSearch, and the Supervertaler MCP Server (connects Claude Desktop to the live Studio session; first of its kind)
- [Supervertaler Workbench](https://supervertaler.com/workbench/): standalone AI translation workbench – multi-LLM translation, TMs, termbases, voice control, clipboard manager
- [Otto](https://otto.supervertaler.com/): automatic document translation – upload a file, get a translated file back. Currently in PRIVATE BETA, not yet publicly available
- [Changelog](https://supervertaler.com/changelog.html): Workbench release history
- [Privacy](https://supervertaler.com/privacy/): privacy policy

## Get it

- [RWS AppStore – Supervertaler for Trados](https://appstore.rws.com/plugin/432)
- [PyPI – Supervertaler Workbench](https://pypi.org/project/supervertaler/): pip install supervertaler
- [GitHub – Workbench releases](https://github.com/Supervertaler/Supervertaler-Workbench/releases): Windows builds

## Optional

- [Documentation index for AI agents](https://docs.supervertaler.com/llms.txt): llms.txt for the full docs, with per-product subsets and a complete content dump
- [MCP Server docs](https://docs.supervertaler.com/trados/mcp-server/): connect your AI assistant to Trados Studio – setup, tools, prompt cookbook
- [beijer.uk](https://beijer.uk/llms.txt): the author's personal site
- [Beijerterm](https://beijerterm.com/llms.txt): the author's Dutch–English terminology site
